description: The US Securities and Exchange Commission has accused eight Colorado-based organisations of running a fraudulent investment scheme that allegedly collected $37.45 million from more than 1,500 Americans. The operation involved fictitious investment advisory firms and cryptocurrency trading platforms that repeatedly changed identities. Investors were encouraged to deposit crypto and fiat currencies, while fake account balances and profits kept them engaged.
title: SEC Takes Action Against Eight Entities in $37 Million Crypto Fraud Case

description: Samsung was missing from the Googlebooks launch, where various laptop manufacturers announced and launched their respective versions of the Googlebook. A new report now sheds light on two Googlebook models being worked on by Samsung, which have leaked in the unreleased OneUI 9.5 beta code.
title: Samsung’s Googlebooks Codenamed ‘Origin’ Show Up in Leaked One UI 9.5 Beta Code

description: Dell XPS 16 Creator Edition has been launched in India with a starting price tag of Rs. 4,49,990. The laptop features an Nvidia RTX Spark chip with up to 128GB of unified memory. It sports a 16-inch 3.2K tandem OLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It is now available for purchase through Dell's online store.
title: Dell XPS 16 Creator Edition Laptop With Nvidia RTX Spark N1X Processor Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: Coinbase, CoinDCX and ZebPay have reported delays or disruptions in Indian rupee withdrawals due to issues involving their banking partners. Coinbase has temporarily disabled its regular withdrawal feature but is processing pending payments through an alternative banking channel. CoinDCX continues to offer withdrawals with longer processing times, while ZebPay has also reported delays.
title: Indian Crypto Exchanges Report INR Withdrawal Disruptions Across Platforms

description: A report says the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 9 and Galaxy Z Fold 9 Ultra have been spotted in the IMEI database. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 9 and Galaxy Z Fold 9 Ultra are reportedly set to launch in July 2027. The Q9 codename could be split into two variants. One listing reportedly belongs to the next-generation Galaxy Z TriFold, while the other codename could refer to the conventional book-style Galaxy Z Fold 9 Ultra. The anticipated launch of the new phones is still months away. Hence, one must read these details with a pinch of salt.
title: Galaxy Z Fold 9, Z Fold 9 Ultra Hit IMEI Database as Samsung Preps Next Foldables

description: Apple is reportedly exploring a new AI assistant that could handle complex requests by working across applications, browsers and external services. A recent job listing points to plans for an agent with coding, web browsing, and device-control capabilities, along with safeguards such as sandboxing and permission controls. The report also highlights changes to Apple's approach to competing AI tools, with macOS 27.3 adding more steps to enable ChatGPT's computer-control features. Meanwhile, iOS 27.3 is expected to expand Siri's integration with third-party apps.
title: Apple is Reportedly Developing AI Agent for App Control, Web Browsing and Coding

description: Nothing's first AI-native device will launch on December 8, the company announced on Friday. The company has shared a new close-up image teasing the product's design. The teaser shows a circular element surrounded by metallic rings.  The upcoming device is expected to mark Nothing's entry into a new category of AI-powered hardware.
title: Nothing’s First Screenless AI Device Launches December 8: Design Teased

description: The Vivo V80 FE is set to launch soon in global markets as the latest addition to the V80 lineup. While the company has yet to announce its availability in India, the purported handset has surfaced on multiple certification sites, suggesting it could launch in the country, too. Ahead of its debut, a tipster has leaked the colourways of the Indian variant. The Vivo V80 FE is tipped to be offered in two colour options.
title: Vivo V80 FE Could Launch in India in Exclusive Red Colour Option, Tipster Claims

description: Redmi R80 5G and Redmi R80m 5G smartphones have been listed in China. They run on MediaTek's Dimensity 6300 chipset. They ship with Xiaomi HyperOS 3 and a 6.9-inch LCD with a 120Hz refresh rate and support up to 240Hz touch sampling.  The Redmi R80 5G is available in three RAM and storage configurations, while the Redmi R80m 5G is listed in two variants.
title: Redmi R80 5G, Redmi R80m 5G Listed: Price, Specs, MediaTek Dimensity 6300 Revealed

description: Nvidia held its RTX Spark Experience event on Friday, showcasing a new category of AI-focused Windows PCs. Several brands unveiled their latest laptops and desktop systems powered by Nvidia’s RTX Spark superchip. The lineup includes slim laptops and compact desktops from Asus, Dell, HP, Lenovo, and MSI. Nvidia says the systems combine a Blackwell RTX GPU and a Grace CPU, offering up to 128GB of unified memory and up to 1 petaflop of FP4 AI performance.
title: Nvidia RTX Spark AI Laptops With 128GB Unified Memory Showcased in India

description: The Huawei Watch Air is expected to feature a 1.92-inch AMOLED display with LTPO 2.0 technology and up to 3,500 nits of peak brightness. It could weigh around 27g and pack a high-silicon stacked battery rated to last up to seven days. The smartwatch is also tipped to offer health tracking features similar to the Huawei Watch 6 and sports tracking capabilities comparable to the Watch GT 7 Pro. Huawei has confirmed three colour options but has yet to disclose pricing.
title: Huawei Watch Air Launching November 24 With 6.9mm Titanium Body; Key Specs Leak

description: Ethereum developers are reconsidering the Glamsterdam upgrade timeline after identifying compatibility problems tied to proposed gas-pricing changes. The review has involved at least 50 affected companies, including exchanges, wallets, and blockchain bridges. While most issues can be addressed through configuration changes, 24 require smart contract fixes or migration, which could push the mainnet launch to 2027.
title: Ethereum Faces Possible Glamsterdam Upgrade Delay Over Network Compatibility

description: Lenovo appears to be preparing to expand its Legion Go gaming handheld lineup with an affordable model. The purported device, dubbed the Lenovo Legion Go Beam, has reportedly surfaced in leaked images. It reportedly features a white-and-green design, built-in controllers, and thick display bezels. The unannounced handheld appears to take a simpler approach than the Legion Go 2, which features a premium OLED screen and detachable controllers.
title: A Cheaper Legion Go 2? Lenovo Legion Go Beam Handheld Leaks in Images

description: Google has announced its Black Friday deals. The promotional event is live and runs through December 1. All offers mentioned below are for unlocked models. During the event, customers can save up to $400 (roughly Rs. 37,000) on Google Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL. Buyers can get an additional exchange bonus of up to $600 (about Rs. 56,000) on an eligible device. Moreover, the Google Black Friday event is offering savings of up to $200 (roughly Rs. 19,000) on the standard Google Pixel 11 model, and an exchange bonus of up to $510 (about Rs. 47,000). Similarly, you can buy the Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold through the Google online store with savings of up to $250 (roughly Rs. 23,000) and an additional $900 (about Rs. 83,000) bonus when you trade in an eligible device.
title: Google Black Friday 2026 Sale Live: Save Up to $600 on Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5

description: Xiaomi 18 pre-orders have started in China ahead of the smartphone's launch. The handset is listed on Xiaomi Mall China. The upcoming phone is expected to feature a 6.4-inch LTPO OLED display. It could feature a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipset and a 7,000mAh battery. It is expected to feature a triple rear camera setup, led by a 200-megapixel primary sensor.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pre-Orders Open in China With Leica Cameras as December Launch Nears

description: After debuting its first MacBook Pro models with a touch-screen tandem OLED display, Apple may now be delaying the switch to OLED displays for the iMac. Now led by new CEO John Ternus, Apple may be considering delaying or abandoning OLED displays on the iMac altogether.
title: Apple OLED iMac Plans Could Be Delayed or Cancelled Under John Ternus

description: Samsung Electronics has appointed four new executives for different businesses as part of the latest corporate overhaul. Won-Joon Choi has been appointed as the new head of the South Korean tech conglomerate’s Mobile eXperience (MX) Business. He currently serves as a President at Samsung Electronics. Choi previously held the position of Chief Operating Officer (COO) of the MX division, which has held since March 2025. The tech giant said that he oversaw the launches of the Samsung Galaxy S26 series and Galaxy Z Fold 8 lineup. The company has also announced that it will retain its Co-CEO structure, retaining President TM Roh and Vice Chairman Young Hyun Jun as the heads of Samsung Electronics. Roh, who previously oversaw the MX Division, will retain his additional charge of the Device eXperience Business. Meanwhile, Jun will continue to head the DS Division.
title: Samsung Leadership Reshuffle: New Heads Named for Mobile, Memory and Chip Units

description: The Xiaomi 18 Pro series was launched in global markets recently, comprising the Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, and the handsets are now expected to make their way to India. Although the company has yet to announce an India launch date, a tipster has leaked the possible pricing of the Xiaomi 18 Pro in the country. If the reported figure is accurate, it would put the upcoming handset in an ultra-premium segment.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Could Cost Up to Rs. 1.7 Lakh in India, Tipster Claims

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number SM-S957B, which reportedly belongs to the handset's India version. The handset has been listed with a Samsung S5E9975 processor, which could be the tech giant’s unreleased deca-core Exynos 2700 chipset, built on a 2nm process. The Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro is shown to feature four cluster 1 cores clocked at 2.88GHz, one cluster 2 core clocked at 3.36GHz, four performance cores clocked at 3.74GHz, and a prime core, delivering a peak clock speed of up to 4.24GHz. It is listed with 10.60GB of RAM, which could be marketed as 12GB of RAM at launch. Moreover, the phone might ship with One UI 9, which is based on Android 17.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro India Variant Hits Geekbench With 2nm Exynos 2700, 12GB RAM

description: DJI's latest price revision affects several configurations of its handheld cameras, with the Osmo Pocket 4P Vlog kit increasing by CNY 560 (roughly Rs. 7,800). The Osmo Pocket 4 kits have also become more expensive, while the 128GB Osmo Nano now costs CNY 2,498 (roughly Rs. 34,800). The 64GB Osmo Nano continues to sell at its earlier price. The revised rates apply to the Chinese market, with no similar changes announced for India.
title: DJI Osmo Pocket 4, Pocket 4P and Osmo Nano Prices Hiked in China

description: Google announced that Computer Use in Gemini is expanding to Mac. The feature aims to automate everyday work by letting the AI assistant interact with desktop applications on a user's behalf. According to the Mountain View-based tech giant, Computer Use is available in the Gemini app for Mac. With the feature, Gemini on Mac can click through menus, type into fields, and complete multi-step tasks across local files, desktop software, and the web.
title: Google Gemini for Mac Gets Computer Use to Automate Desktop Apps and Fill Forms

description: GTA 6 is in no rush to show you the airtight consistency of its many, many moving parts. In fact, the game wants you to relax, slow down, fix the leaks in your roof, shoot the shit with your friends, and decide which way your couch should face. It wants you to take in the view before worrying about the big picture.
title: GTA 6 First Impressions: Rockstar Builds on Red Dead Redemption 2’s Best Ideas

description: Canva's new settings give individual users more control over the platform's AI tools and generated content. While disabling generative AI hides these features across Canva, a separate option reduces the number of AI-generated images and assets shown in library searches and recommendations. Background Remover and Magic Grab will continue to work even when generative AI is turned off. Free and Pro subscribers can access the controls, while administrators on Business, Enterprise, Teams, and Education plans already have AI management settings.
title: Canva Rolls Out New AI Control Settings for Free and Pro Users

description: Apple has revealed details of its Black Friday event. Apple will kick off the promotional event on November 27, and the deals will be live until November 30, known as Cyber Monday. During the promotional event, the John Ternus-led tech giant will offer gift cards worth up to $300 (roughly Rs. 28,000) on different iPhone, MacBook, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and AirPods models, similar to last year. Apple will offer a $100 gift card (about Rs. 9,300) with the iPhone Air. Meanwhile, customers can get a $75 gift card (roughly Rs. 7,000) with the iPhone 17 and iPhone 16. iPad Air and iPad Pro models will come with a gift card worth up to $125 (roughly Rs. 12,000). Apple will offer the highest-value gift card, worth $300 (about Rs. 28,000), with the MacBook Pro and MacBook Air models.
title: Apple Black Friday 2026 Deals: Up to $300 Gift Cards on iPhone Air, Mac and iPad

description: Bitcoin and Ethereum continued to decline as institutional withdrawals, weak investor sentiment, and expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes weighed on cryptocurrency markets. Analysts highlighted heavy selling by long-term Bitcoin holders, substantial liquidations, and growing uncertainty about the market’s near-term direction. Investors are now watching US PCE inflation data due on November 25 for clues about the Federal Reserve’s next policy decision.
title: Bitcoin Price Falls to Roughly Rs. 57.1 Lakh, Ethereum at Rs. 1.60 Lakh Amid Crypto Sell-Off

description: According to Counterpoint Research, US smartphone shipments fell 9 percent year-over-year (YoY) during the third quarter 2026. Rising memory costs are putting pressure on Android manufacturers. Apple took the top spot with 57 percent market share. Apple was the only OEM in the US smartphone market that saw growth during the quarter.
title: US Smartphone Shipments Fall in Q3 2026 as Apple Hits 57 Percent Share, Samsung 25 Percent: Counterpoint

description: After launching its Watch 6 Pro smartwatch in China back in September, Honor has now launched the same globally, primarily for European markets. The Honor Watch 6 Pro will be available in two strap options and uses the Honor Polaris positioning system for stable reception in the wilderness.
title: Honor Watch 6 Pro Launched Globally With 1.5-inch Tandem OLED Display, 18 Day Battery Life and IP69K Durability

description: Lava Smart 4 Pro has been launched in India as the third addition to the company's Smart 4 lineup. The smartphone is available exclusively in India through Lava’s offline retail channels. Like other Lava handsets, the tech firm is offering free doorstep service to customers across India. The Lava Smart 4 Pro is available in two colours, Konark Gold and Neelam Blue. The Lava Smart 4 Pro is a dual-SIM smartphone. The affordable handset ships with Android 16, and the company claims that it features “no bloatware and no ads”. The Lava Smart 4 series phone also features a 6.75-inch HD+ (720 x 1,570 pixels) LCD touchscreen with up to a 90Hz refresh rate. The Noida-based smartphone maker claims that its new handset ships with MIL-STD-810H military-grade certification for drop and shock resistance.
title: Lava Smart 4 Pro Launched in India With 7,000mAh Battery and 13-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: OpenAI has been rumoured to be developing an agentic phone for quite a while now. The rumour mill suggests that the ChatGPT maker wants to build an AI-focused smartphone with deeper integration between its software stack and hardware. While details about the device remain scarce, a new supply-chain report suggests that the company may have found a manufacturing partner. The purported handset will reportedly arrive in late 2027 or 2028.
title: OpenAI Reportedly Taps Foxconn Subsidiary to Assemble Its First Agentic Smartphone

description: Google has announced new requirements for apps published on the Google Play Store. The company has made adaptive support mandatory for foldable devices from April 2027. Apps that fail to meet the requirements will not be allowed to publish new releases or updates on the Play Store. The company has also introduced dedicated screenshot requirements for foldable devices.
title: Google Play Mandates Foldable Screenshots and Adaptive Design Standards for Apps Starting April 2027

description: Renders of the Motorola Razr Flex 2027 leaked on the Web again. The new set of renders shows the handset in Pantone Dark Botanical Garden and Pantone Coriander colour options. The Dark Botanical Garden variant appears to feature a woven fabric-like texture on the rear panel, while the Coriander version is shown with a leather-like finish. The handset is tipped to feature a 4.97-inch cover display and a 6.92-inch primary screen.
title: Motorola Razr Flex 2027 Renders Leak Online, Suggests Two Colour Options

description: Vehicle owners in India are required to keep a valid Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate to ensure that their vehicles meet the prescribed emission standards. The document is important not only for complying with traffic regulations but also for monitoring the pollutants released by vehicles on the road. However, remembering its expiry date can be easy to overlook. The renewal period varies depending on the vehicle's emission standard and age. The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways has also revised PUC certificate validity periods based on these factors.
title: How to Check PUC Certificate Validity Online: New Rules, Renewal Periods Explained
